asset.name: SharedElementTransition
asset.description: The transition carrying a stable element between views by coordinating geometry, clipping, content handoff, and interruption, so an object keeps its identity across a navigation.

requires.reason: Every spacing, size, and radius value resolves to a declared ramp rather than a literal.
Motion policy is resolved through the shared hook so the preference can be overridden and tested.
Shared elements are measured and animated inside a coordination boundary.

signatureMoment.description: An object the user selected visibly travels to its destination rather than disappearing and reappearing, so its identity is never in doubt.
